title: Inventive AI vs Arphie vs HeyIris (2026): Which AI RFP Tool Fits
summary: Inventive AI vs Arphie vs HeyIris compared on what happens when sources disagree, go stale, or run out, plus pricing, integrations, and verified G2 reviews.
body_markdown:
Inventive AI vs Arphie vs HeyIris is a comparison of three AI-native request for proposal (RFP) platforms that all draft cited answers from connected company knowledge. What separates them is what each one does when that knowledge disagrees with itself, goes out of date, or simply doesn't have the answer. Inventive AI is an AI-native RFP platform that drafts cited answers from your connected company knowledge and flags conflicting or outdated content before it reaches a buyer.


**Key takeaways**


- **Inventive AI governs the knowledge itself:** it checks your sources against each other, flags contradictions and stale content before drafting, and costs $830/month, billed annually, with unlimited users.
- **Arphie is the most transparent drafter:** each answer shows its source, confidence score, and reasoning, and Arphie flags answers that may be outdated when a connected document changes.
- **HeyIris covers the widest range of documents:** RFPs, proposals, DDQs, and[security questionnaires](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/how-to-answer-a-security-questionnaire) , with unlimited volume per paid seat and deal context from Gong and Salesforce.
- **All three connect to Claude and ChatGPT through MCP,** so governance and pricing are where they really differ.

## What should you test when comparing Inventive AI, Arphie, and HeyIris?


All three draft well on clean content, so test them on the messy content you actually have.


1. **The conflict test:** connect two documents that state different pricing tiers or SLAs, then see which tool flags the disagreement and which picks one silently.
2. **The staleness test:** update one fact in a source document, then check which tool's next draft uses the new version.
3. **The gap test:** ask five questions your content can't answer, and see which tool says so.
4. **The setup test:** time how long it takes to connect sources and get a first usable draft, since G2 reviewers average about a month to implement Arphie and HeyIris.
5. **The seat test:** count every SME and approver who needs access, because only one of the three includes unlimited users at a published price.
6. **The assistant test:** connect each tool's MCP server to Claude or ChatGPT and ask the same question, then check the citation that comes back.


## What happens when two of your sources disagree?


Only Inventive AI publishes a check for contradictions across your sources. Arphie and HeyIris handle overlap in other ways.


- **Inventive AI:** the AI Content Manager compares documents across the[Knowledge Hub](https://www.inventive.ai/features/knowledge-hub) and flags conflicting, duplicate, and outdated content before it reaches a draft. G2 reviewers on security teams call this out, since policies often differ across teams.
- **Arphie:** Smart Merge surfaces overlapping entries so a person can combine them, and each answer shows the reasoning behind it, which helps reviewers spot a bad source.
- **HeyIris:** learns from approved responses over time. It doesn't publish a contradiction check, and a few G2 reviewers mention inaccurate responses.


## How do Inventive AI, Arphie, and HeyIris keep content from going stale?


All three lean on live sources, but they react to change differently.


- **Inventive AI:** flags outdated content automatically, so the old version doesn't keep appearing in drafts after a policy or product change.
- **Arphie:** recognizes when a connected document changes, such as an updated pitch deck, and flags answers that may now be outdated.
- **HeyIris:** finds the latest version of a document and attaches it to the answer. One G2 reviewer notes that setting up and tagging the knowledge base takes time.


## What do Inventive AI, Arphie, and HeyIris do when content can't answer a question?


All three say so instead of guessing, which is the right default for any AI-native tool.


- **Inventive AI:** marks the question as information unavailable and routes it to an SME.
- **Arphie:** says plainly when its sources can't support an answer.
- **HeyIris:** flags the gap rather than inventing an answer, a point G2 reviewers praise.


## Inventive AI vs Arphie vs HeyIris: how do they compare head to head?


### Inventive AI vs Arphie: which is better?


Inventive AI fits teams whose biggest risk is contradictory or outdated source content. Arphie fits teams whose reviewers want to see the AI's reasoning on every answer.


- **Governance:** Inventive AI flags contradictions across sources. Arphie flags overlapping entries and outdated answers.
- **Pricing:** Inventive AI publishes $830/month with unlimited users. Arphie quotes each customer.
- **Strategy:** Inventive AI adds go/no-go and competitive analysis through[strategic agents](https://www.inventive.ai/features/agents) . Arphie doesn't publish either.


### Inventive AI vs HeyIris: which is better?


Inventive AI fits broad teams that want every SME included at one price. HeyIris fits smaller teams running heavy volume who want deal context in their drafts.


- **Users and cost:** Inventive AI includes unlimited users. HeyIris includes unlimited questionnaires per paid seat.
- **Deal context:** HeyIris pulls context from Gong and Salesforce. Inventive AI focuses on governed company knowledge.
- **Portals:** Inventive AI fills Coupa, Ariba, and Jaggaer through[Portal Answers](https://www.inventive.ai/features/portal-answers) . HeyIris uses a Chrome extension for web portals.


### Arphie vs HeyIris: which is better for keeping answers accurate?


Arphie gives reviewers more insight into each answer, while HeyIris leans on approved responses and the latest evidence.


- **Arphie:** reasoning on every answer and alerts when a source document changes.
- **HeyIris:** passage-level citations and automatic attachment of the newest evidence.
- **Shared gap:** neither publishes a check for contradictions between source documents.


## How do Inventive AI, Arphie, and HeyIris pricing compare?


Inventive AI is the only one with a published price.


- **Inventive AI:** $830/month, billed annually, with unlimited users and every feature in one plan.
- **Arphie:**[Arphie pricing](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/arphie-pricing-features-reviews) is a custom quote.

## Frequently Asked Questions


### Is HeyIris the same as Iris?


Yes. HeyIris is the company and website, and Iris is the product name on G2.


### How long does setup take for Inventive AI, Arphie, and HeyIris?


Most Inventive AI teams start within days. Arphie says switching usually takes under a week, and G2 reviewers report about a month to implement both Arphie and HeyIris.


### Can Inventive AI, Arphie, and HeyIris import a Loopio or Responsive library?


Yes. Inventive AI connects an exported library as one more source, Arphie migrates content from legacy RFP software in a few clicks, and HeyIris onboards from existing approved responses.


### Which helps decide whether to bid?


Inventive AI and HeyIris both score go/no-go fit, and Inventive AI adds competitive analysis. Arphie doesn't publish a go/no-go feature.


### Which is best for a small team?


HeyIris suits a small team with heavy volume, since each paid seat includes unlimited questionnaires. Inventive AI suits small teams that still need many occasional contributors, since every user is included.


### Do Inventive AI, Arphie, and HeyIris offer a free trial?


None offers a self-serve trial. All three sell through a demo and a quote.
